title: Prediction
description: Predict what should and should not be extracted from a form.
prompt: A team wants reusable forms. Which extraction is usually the safest first step?

options.label: Create one generic form engine for every future form.
Extract repeated field label, help text, and error layout.
Move all field state into a child component so the form cannot see it.

responses.generic-form-engine: Not quite. A generic engine is usually too early before several real forms prove the same needs.
responses.field-structure: Correct. Repeated field structure is a narrow, useful extraction that keeps behavior visible.
responses.hide-state: Not quite. Hiding the state can make validation and submit behavior harder to reason about.

metadata.reason: Catches the misconception that reuse should start with a broad form abstraction.
